description: Returns the Markdown document of any public page, exactly as HTTP serves it, from a root-relative path (/patterns/supervisor.md) or a https://topologyindex.com URL. Private tenant routes are not reachable here. A pattern, starter or formation read may add a second item containing a one-time use ticket and an instruction to call `report_outcome` after applying it; pattern and starter redemptions can return indexed pitfalls, checks or a pairing suggestion.
name: fetch
title: Fetch a public page
